lake-build-guard.sh exits 0 when the lake subcommand after -- is malformed (e.g. '-- TARGET' instead of '-- build TARGET'), emitting "error: unknown command" while still returning success; a caller trusting the exit code alone reads a failed build as a pass

woken predecessor (Phase 1, dispatch_seq 3) restored and re-wrote .orchestrator-handoff.json and .return-meta.json AFTER Phase 2's dispatch window opened; mtime 1788246672 > dispatch_start_ts 1788246604, so the mtime gate alone would have accepted a seq-3 report as Phase 2's outcome. dispatch_seq gate is the discriminator that catches it

guard's result sharing returned a completed scoped-build result for a subsequent full build: reported 1364 jobs with output identical to the preceding scoped FormalSystem.Semantics build, masquerading as a full-tree pass. --no-share produced the genuine 2506-job build. A caller cannot distinguish a shared partial result from a real full build by exit code or job count alone
